{"step":8,"file":"wpantund/src/wpantund/NCPInstanceBase-Addresses.cpp","function":"NCPInstanceBase::unicast_address_was_removed","line":620,"var":"mUnicastAddresses.erase(address)","code":"mUnicastAddresses.erase(address);","note":"The bookkeeping entry is erased before the tunnel-interface removal is issued, so later callbacks can observe stale state."},
{"step":9,"file":"wpantund/src/wpantund/NCPInstanceBase-Addresses.cpp","function":"NCPInstanceBase::unicast_address_was_removed","line":623,"var":"mPrimaryInterface->remove_address(&address, entry.get_prefix_len())","code":"mPrimaryInterface->remove_address(&address, entry.get_prefix_len());","note":"The same address object is forwarded to the tunnel interface for deletion, which is the path that reaches the reported sink."},
